steps.content: You rush to the manor's entrance, arriving just in time to see the messenger's retreating back. The crucial letter is already in the hands of the gate guard.
Faced with your request, the guard is an unyielding statue, his loyalty to protocol absolute.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: The officer's orders are clear. All intelligence letters must go directly to her. I cannot relinquish it to anyone else.
Helpless, you can only watch as the guard turns and carries the letter into the main hall, sealing your fate.
You are escorted to Hilda's room with grim efficiency.
The questioning begins calmly, then sharpens when you offer no answers. Finally, with a disappointed sigh, she begins the formal interrogation.
The truth serum pulls you under, and your consciousness becomes a flood you cannot control. What secrets have you revealed? You may never know.
You think to yourself in a daze.
The next time you meet, she will have no memory of this. You will start again, as strangers meeting for the first time.
